description: June 27 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 27 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: June 27 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Late June's lunar Cancer, five degrees in, meets 9, the number of compassion and endings. The 27th is often read as an empath with wide reach, someone whose caring extends beyond family to strangers, animals and causes. The Moon decan intensifies feeling, so boundaries matter; the traditional advice is to give generously while keeping something in reserve.

On June 27 the Sun usually sits at about 5° Cancer, in the first decan, where Moon rules the decan as well as the sign. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: June 27 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 27 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on June 27: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 27 is the 178th day of the year (179th in a leap year). By July 23, 26 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 27 include Helen Keller (1880), Emma Goldman (1869) and Isabelle Adjani (1955).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 27?
faq.answer: June 27 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 27 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 27?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 27 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 27?
faq.answer: June 27 is also the birthday of Helen Keller (1880), Emma Goldman (1869) and Isabelle Adjani (1955). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
